implementation.name: original-v4-12-capture-to-onset
implementation.scope: Original timing/travel strip, exact canonical interval endpoints at the chosen aisle speed. Dispatch allocation is unqualified; constant-speed travel maps the pre-onset budget only. Base icon follows the original travel row; icon size is schematic.
implementation.question: Which clock pays for the path to brake onset?

purpose: Accumulate the original interval bars and corresponding travel while keeping observation age, dispatch allocation, and admission-relative lease clocks distinct.
guard: Lease starts at admission, observation age starts at capture, and dispatch-to-admission belongs to neither. Time is not double-counted. No motion after brake onset is simulated.
